name: imagen
title_zh: Gemini 原生出图，草图到成品不换窗口
tagline_zh: UI 稿、图标、示意图、概念图，一句话的事。不用切去 Midjourney，不用调参数，它自己会按你的描述补细节。
tagline_en: UI mocks, icons, diagrams, concept art — just ask. No Midjourney detour, no prompt tuning; it fills in the.
desc_en: Generate images using Google Gemini's image generation capabilities. Use this skill when the user needs to create, generate, or produce images for any purpose including UI mockups, icons, illustrations, diagrams, concept art, placeholder images, or visual representations.
why_zh: 直接调 Gemini 官方图像接口，不是套壳。理解长描述里的空间关系和材质，出图后还能继续对话改局部。
why_en: Calls Gemini's official image API directly — no wrapper. It parses spatial relations and materials in long prompts, and you can.
limit_zh: 只认 Gemini 付费 API key，免费额度出不了图。产出一张静态位图，不生成 SVG、动图或 3D 模型。
limit_en: Requires a paid Gemini API key (free tier can't generate). Outputs one static raster image only — no SVG, GIF, or 3D. Chinese prompts parse worse.
title_en: Native Gemini image gen, sketch to finish in one window
